scoreSemantics.twinFidelity: How closely the generated baryonic map matches the registered real baryonic map.
scoreSemantics.formulaTransport: How much a fixed formula prediction changes when the registered map is replaced by its fake twin.
scoreSemantics.observationalAccuracy: How far the formula prediction on the fake twin is from the observed H I velocity field.

classification.consistent: field RMSE divided by declared uncertainty RMS is at most 1
classification.close: ratio is greater than 1 and at most 2

executionBoundary.protocolStatusMeaning: The frozen comparison executed with finite leakage-audited scores; it does not mean either formula passed every galaxy.

claimBoundary: P0744 is the first direct real 2D velocity-field comparison for these spiral twins, but it uses the development sample and is not a holdout result.
Systemic velocity and handedness are observation-coordinate nuisances, not gravity parameters; both are disclosed per galaxy.
No pressure-support, warp, bar, streaming, inclination, distance, M/L, MOND, or halo parameter is fitted to a residual in this raw comparison.
A model can fail because its circular-equilibrium prediction is wrong or because unmodeled gas dynamics dominate; P0744 alone cannot uniquely separate those causes.
Validation and holdout velocity arrays remain sealed.
